plugins.name: costar-coach-plugin
plugins.description: Converts rough descriptions or ideas into well-structured prompts using the COSTAR framework (Context, Objective, Style, Tone, Audience, Response). Coaches patiently -- asks one focused question when a component is missing rather than guessing -- and embeds the same patient, ask-don't-guess behavior into every generated prompt. Offers to execute the prompt immediately after presenting it.

plugins.name: crispe-coach-plugin
plugins.description: Converts rough descriptions or ideas into well-structured prompts using the CRISPE framework (Context, Role, Instruction, Specification, Performance, Example). Coaches patiently -- asks one focused question when a component is missing rather than guessing -- and embeds the same patient, ask-don't-guess behavior into every generated prompt. Offers to execute the prompt immediately after presenting it.

plugins.name: auto-skill-update-plugin
plugins.description: Automatically detects when a skill was recently used and the user signals it should be improved, then applies minimal, surgical edits to the skill definition -- covering new trigger patterns, handling cases, or examples without rewriting wholesale.

plugins.name: prompt-convert-trigger-plugin
plugins.description: Automatically detects complex or multi-step tasks and converts them into structured COSTAR or CRISPE prompts. Triggers proactively when user requests involve 3+ steps, multiple conditions, vague requirements, multi-file scope, or research plus implementation work.

plugins.name: crispe-system-architect-plugin
plugins.description: Expert program architecture analyzer that generates documentation for any code repository. Supports three output styles: Choice 1 (CONTRIBUTING.md + STRUCTURE.md -- contribution guide alongside a separate structure reference), Choice 2 (CLAUDE.md -- single merged AI context file), Choice 3 (STRUCTURE.md only -- structure reference without a contribution guide). STRUCTURE.md, ARCHITECTURE.md, and OVERVIEW.md are treated as equivalent -- updates the one that already exists, or creates STRUCTURE.md if none is present. Triggers proactively before code changes when no documentation file exists, and explicitly when the user asks to analyze a repo, generate STRUCTURE.md/CLAUDE.md/CONTRIBUTING.md, summarize the codebase, or document the project structure.
